Bring your farm’s economy to life with a collectible card-based selling system inspired by classic TCGs like Pokémon — with fully randomized idol stats, progression, fusions, star upgrades, and a dynamic market loop.[/b]
And yes: [b]this mod includes an original, self-composed MARKET SOUNDTRACK from SwayCee!!![/b] that plays while your idol is active. 🎵🔥

But the IDOLS are all [u][b]AI produced[/b][/u]! ;) so if AI ist not for you! But the Soundtrack ist handmade from a real musician....! 

[line]
⭐ What is Sexy Market Idols?[b]Sexy Market Idols[/b] adds a [b]brand-new collectible card system[/b] where you gather “Idol Seller” cards and use them to run your very own automated market stand.
Instead of throwing items into the Shipping Bin every day for the same repetitive profit… you’ll build a [b]real market economy[/b] with [b]risk, rewards, bad deals, special events, and daily Hot Item trends[/b].
This mod is all about:
✅ [b]collection[/b] • ✅ [b]progression[/b] • ✅ [b]random rolls[/b] • ✅ [b]min-maxing stats[/b] • ✅ [b]making money in a more exciting way
[/b]
[line]
🎁 How do you start?
On [b]Day 1[/b], you’ll receive everything during an event from [b]Mayor Lewis[/b].
You start with:

[list]
[*][b]3x Display Tables (You can buy them at Robins Carpenter Shop)[/b][/*]
[*][b]1x Idol Statue[/b] (your active seller slot)[/*]
[*][b]1x Chest[/b] (market storage)[/*]
[*]The core systems unlocked instantly[/*]
[/list][line]
⚠️ IMPORTANT Compatibility Warning (MUST READ!)This mod is [b]NOT compatible[/b] with [b]any mod that triggers a scripted Day 1 event immediately after leaving the farmhouse[/b] (or overrides that exact timing).
If another mod hijacks that moment, the Sexy Market Idols intro event may not trigger correctly.

[line]
🃏 Cards = Your SellersEach card represents a [b]Market Idol[/b] — a collectible seller with unique stats and behaviors.
Cards come in 4 rarities:
[list]
[*][b]Common[/b][/*]
[*][b]Rare[/b][/*]
[*][b]Epic[/b][/*]
[*][b]Legendary[/b][/*]
[/list]Cards are [b]randomly rolled when obtained[/b], which means two copies of the same idol can still feel completely different.

[line]
📈 Core Card Stats (and why they matter)Every idol has multiple attributes that affect the market in real gameplay:
[b]Salesmanship
[/b]Determines how likely the idol is to successfully sell an item.
[b]Charm[/b]
Controls whether your idol can get [b]bonus money[/b] from a sale — and [b]how much extra[/b] profit you gain.
[b]Reliability[/b]
Affects “Bad Events”:
Low reliability increases the chance of sales that [b]fail[/b] or [b]earn no money[/b], even if the item technically sells.
High Reliability affect the [b]MARKETCRY[/b] chance! 
[b]Capacity
[/b]Determines how much your idol can handle at once and how efficient her market flow is. tl;TR: How many DisplayTables can be used by the Idol

[line]
📣 Market Cry (High Risk, High Reward!)Reliability has an extra twist:
[list]
[*][b]Low Reliability[/b] → higher chance of “bad deals” (sales with 0 profit)[/*]
[*][b]High Reliability[/b] → increases the chance to trigger a powerful special event:[/*]
[/list][b]Market Cry[/b]Your idol performs a [b]Market Cry[/b], calling [b]all nearby NPCs to the market area[/b] for a surge of potential buyers.
This can massively boost your market momentum and profits when used smartly.

[line]
⛏️ Get Cards From the Mines (Booster-Pack Feeling)Cards are found through [b]mine drops[/b], giving it that true collectible “booster pack” vibe and through fishing-Treasure Chests.
Open packs, discover idols, roll stats, and build your dream seller lineup.

[u][b]There is a GMCM-Menu so you can change everythin to your liking![/b][/u]


[line]
🔥 Daily Hot Item Courier (Seasonal Visuals!)Every morning, a [b]Hot Item Courier[/b] arrives and tells you what’s trending today.
✅ The courier’s appearance changes based on the [b]current season[/b].
✅ Hot Items have [b]100% sell chance[/b], making this the perfect day to:

[list]
[*][b]farm huge profit[/b][/*]
[*][b]power-level your idols[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
🧠 Automatic Selling System (Smart + Addictive)Here’s the magic market loop:

[list=1]
[*]Put items into your [b]Market Chest[/b]
[/*]
[*]Insert an Idol Card into the [b]Idol Statue[/b]
[/*]
[*]The idol automatically chooses what to sell based on her logic & stats
[/*]
[*]Items move from the chest → to sales → profit & progression
[/*]
[/list]It’s [b]hands-off[/b], but still strategic:
Your idol’s stats decide if you become a market legend… or get outplayed by RNG.

[line]
🌟 Leveling, Fusion & Star UpgradesProgression is a huge part of the mod.
[b]Leveling 
[/b]Idols gain XP through selling.
[b]Each level-up rolls stats differently[/b],
meaning progression stays exciting and unpredictable.
[b]Fusion / Sacrifice[/b]
You can sacrifice a max-level idol to transfer XP into another card.
⚠️ Only [b]50% of XP[/b] is transferred — choose wisely.
[b]Star System (Duplicate Upgrades)[/b]
If you find [b]two copies of the same idol[/b], you can merge them to gain [b]stars[/b].
Stars are a long-term upgrade path that turns favorites into true endgame sellers.

[line]
🌸 Seasonal Tags & WildcardsIdols are grouped by seasonal themes:

[list]
[*][b]Spring Cards[/b][/*]
[*][b]Summer Cards[/b][/*]
[*][b]Fall Cards[/b][/*]
[*][b]Winter Cards[/b][/*]
[/list]And then there are…
[b]Wildcards[/b]They can be used anytime — but behave differently than seasonal cards.
(And yes… how exactly they work is a surprise 😉)

[line]
🎵 Original Custom Market MusicThis deserves its own section because it’s a huge part of the vibe:
✅ [b]Sexy Market Idols includes a fully self-composed Market Soundtrack.[/b]
When an idol is active in the Idol Statue, the [b]custom market audio kicks in[/b] and transforms the entire experience into something that feels like an actual event.
This isn’t reused vanilla music.
This is [b]made specifically for the mod.
[/b]
[line]
💡 Why this mod exists
Because the Shipping Bin gets boring fast.
The classic loop is:
[quote]dump items → sleep → get the same report → repeat forever[/quote]Sexy Market Idols replaces that with:
✅ daily trends
✅ market hype moments
✅ collectible progression
✅ randomness + build diversity
✅ a system that rewards experimenting and upgrading

You’re not just farming.
You’re building a [b]market empire[/b].

[line]

[*][b]Original self-composed Market Soundtrack[/b][/*]
[/list]
